statements.text: The base variable is the temporal current $J^\mu = \rho_t u^\mu$, a temporal density carried along a future-directed timelike flow, obeying $\nabla_\mu J^\mu = 0$. Temporal density may be redistributed by the flow but is never created or destroyed by local evolution.

sources.quote: The starting point of the Chronoflux framework is the temporal current
Its physical content is that temporal density may be redistributed by the flow, but it is not created or destroyed by the local evolution itself.
